construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Explicitly synthetic resources, catalog entries and source passages; strict allowlisted fields, unique IDs, validated patient/source references.
shared_schema.resources: FHIR-style Patient anonymous alias, ClinicalNote text, PriorAuthorizationRequest reason/status. Every resource explicitly requires human review.
shared_schema.output: Shared envelope carries immutable validated input, records enriched through sentiment/search/research, stage, human review flag, null clinical decision and ordered before/after audit.
shared_schema.validation: validate_input and validate_envelope protect every stage boundary; deterministic recomputation validates each output and exact audit replay.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated normalized query terms and severity-aware priority drive catalog retrieval.
Validated top catalog results limit research to their source IDs; query terms retrieve passages and priority is retained.

behavior.sentiment: Transparent word weights with two-token negation; severity cues conservatively retained even if negated. Priority = severity*100 + capped negative score magnitude; review triage only, not medical urgency assessment.
behavior.search: General-purpose token overlap with a small synonym dictionary; top three products, deterministic ID tie-breaking, matched-term explanations.
behavior.research: Top three matching passages from retrieved sources only; full passage extraction with exact source ID, passage ID, quote and character offsets. Empty retrieval explicitly reports no_matching_evidence.
behavior.healthcare: Strict anonymous patient aliases and field allowlists reject names, birth dates and structured identifiers. Conservative free-text patterns reject common identifier forms. Original clinical resources and authorization status never change.
behavior.audit: Every record enrichment has a sequence, actor, stage, path, before/after value and human-review flag. Read-only original resources need no change event.
behavior.errors: CLI emits one JSON error object and exits 2 on invalid input or file failure; unsafe input content and paths are not echoed.

included: Synthetic Synthea-style fixture with fictitious diagnosis and lab value
excluded: Actual HIPAA certification or comprehensive free-text de-identification
Clinical decision-making, diagnosis or treatment recommendations
